access.title: PIN needed
access.ask.manager: A manager or the owner must allow this. Type your PIN:
access.ask.owner: Only the owner can do this. Owner, type your PIN:
access.signin.prompt: Type your staff PIN. Everything you do is recorded under your name
access.signedout: Signed out. The app is back on counter mode
staff.title: Staff
staff.hint: Give each manager and cashier their own PIN. A manager runs the shop but cannot restore backups or change the UPI ID, staff, shops or subscription. A cashier bills and takes payment.
staff.grants.title: What cashiers may do without a manager
staff.grants.hint: On: the cashier can do it directly, and each time is recorded with their name. Off: a manager's PIN is asked.
staff.pin.title: Staff PIN
activity.hint: Protected actions in the last 30 days: who did them and who allowed them
customers.remove.confirm: Remove '{0}' from the list? Their old bills stay as they are.
chain.title: Chain & branches
chain.hint: If one owner has several shops: each branch phone sends a daily report file to the owner, and the owner's phone shows every branch's sales. Items and customer details never leave the branch phone, only totals.
chain.code.prompt: Use the same code on every phone (the owner's and each branch). At least 6 characters. Keep it private.
chain.branch.title: If this is a branch phone
chain.branch.hint: Send this shop's last 14 days of totals to the owner (for example on WhatsApp).
chain.share.title: Angadi branch report
chain.head.title: If this is the owner's phone
chain.head.hint: Pick the file a branch sent. Import again each time a new report arrives.
chain.remove.confirm: Remove the reports of '{0}' from this phone? Nothing changes on that shop's phone.
chain.imported.newer: You already have a newer report from this branch — nothing changed
export.title: Excel (CSV) files
export.hint: Makes a file for your accountant or yourself. Opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
export.share.title: Angadi file
cloud.title: Cloud sync
cloud.hint: When on, this shop's records (bills, stock, payments) are copied to the Angadi server, for the chain owner and as a safe copy. Billing never waits for the internet; records are sent when it's back.
cloud.unavailable: Cloud sync isn't available in this version yet
cloud.rejected: {0} records were refused by the server — they are kept safely on this phone
cloud.link.confirm: This shop's records will be copied to the Angadi server. Turn it on?
chain.live.title: Live chain (internet)
chain.live.needsync: Turn on cloud sync first to use the live chain.
chain.live.hint: The head shop taps "Create live chain" and gets a code; each branch joins with that code. The owner then sees every branch's sales automatically, with no files to send.
chain.live.name: Chain name
chain.live.code.title: Code for your branches
chain.live.code:
Give this code to each branch: {0}
It is shown only once, so write it down.
chain.live.head: This shop is the head of "{0}" · {1} shops
chain.live.member: This shop sends live to the "{0}" chain · {1} shops
